title: Schemes over a base and morphisms over it
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme. A *scheme over $S$* (an *$S$-scheme*) is a scheme $X$ equipped with a morphism of schemes $X\to S$, called its *structure morphism*. For a commutative ring $R$, a *scheme over $R$* (an $R$-scheme) means a scheme over $\operatorname{Spec}R$. A *morphism of schemes over $S$* (an *$S$-morphism*) $f:X\to Y$ between $S$-schemes is a morphism of schemes such that the composite of $f$ with the structure morphism of $Y$ equals the structure morphism of $X$; $\operatorname{Hom}_S(X,Y)$ (also written $\operatorname{Mor}_S(X,Y)$) denotes the set of $S$-morphisms from $X$ to $Y$, and $\operatorname{Hom}_R$ means $\operatorname{Hom}_{\operatorname{Spec}R}$. The $S$-schemes and $S$-morphisms form the category $\mathit{Sch}/S$ of schemes over $S$.
